new_row.statement: Retain the original marked source \[ y^2=x^3+rx^2+tx+t^2,\qquad G=(0,t),\qquad s=\tfrac14-r, \qquad M_6=\mathcal O(6G-O), \] the suspension by \(-G\), and the quadratic reduced-IV cap \((a,b;m,n)=(6,1;2,1)\). Retain its prescribed finite character, complete annular reference \(F_0\), original physical circle and all source and target Cartier factors. Select the node branch \(w\) near \(-1\), where \[ D=w^2-3,\qquad r=\frac{3-2w^2}{D^2},\qquad t_{\rm coll}=\frac{w^2-1}{D^3},\qquad q=t-t_{\rm coll}, \qquad Z=\frac{S-w}{S+w}. \] Use one positive small original \(s\)-circle, the identity source closing and the sufficiently small fixed scalar of ASI3. For every unimodular selected lattice-basis fan \(T(P)\), the full source, line, cap and closing maps below give the oriented return and calculate its class in \(\Theta_7=\mathbb Z/28\) by AFI.1--5. For the initial fan \(T_0\), the completed physical Jin pair, its fixed-\(C_0\) free coordinates and its return are \[ (k_M,\ell_M)=(47,-4),\qquad(\mu,\nu)=(-1,48),\qquad [\Sigma]=\frac{4k_M-\ell_M}{24}=8\pmod{28}. \] For every signed vertical fan \(T_j=T(e_1+je_2,e_2)\), the actual integer comparison gives \[ k_j=47-2j^3+18j^2-52j,\qquad \ell_j=-4, \] \[ (\mu_j,\nu_j)=(-1,48-2j^3+18j^2-52j),\qquad S_j=8-\frac{j(j^2-9j+26)}3\in\mathbb Z. \] Its return is \(S_j\bmod28\). In particular the reflected initial fan \(T_1\) has class \(2\). The literal marked-source reflection carries the branch near \(w=+1\) with the corresponding reflected fan and the same original cap data. Every basis fan is reached by the finite canonical fan word of AFI.4 from its signed vertical seed. At each step the complete period and coefficient maps, native Cox reset and target trace system calculate the next return; the single native addition is \((\delta_i-V_{ii})/4\), obtained in the free relative group before reduction modulo \(28\). The complete image on the stated basis fans is all of \(\mathbb Z/28\). The proof supplies all28 actual witnesses, each starting at \(T_0\) and using at most seven native flops, with its complete step records. For example the basis \(\bigl(\begin{smallmatrix}2&-1\\-1&1\end{smallmatrix}\bigr)\) is obtained by \(C_0,C_1\), with integer additions \(48,300\); its return is \(8+48+300=356\equiv20\pmod{28}\).

Retain the original marked E6 source and point line \[ y^2=x^3+rx^2+tx+t^2,\qquad G=(0,t),\qquad s=\tfrac14-r,\qquad M_2=\mathcal O([2G]-[O]). \] Here \([2G]\) is the doubled section. The suspension is the actual three chronological translations by \(-G\), hence the source step \(-3G\), with its full selected Hom section. Explicitly, for \(T(p)=p-G\), retain \[ f_2=\frac{y-t-x/2}{x-s},\qquad B_{2,3}(p)=f_2(p)f_2(T^3p)f_2(Tp)^2f_2(T^2p)^2, \qquad B_{\rm sel}=\frac{q}{t^3}B_{2,3}. \] The selected source zero and its marking are \[ \begin{gathered} \rho^2=1-3r,\qquad \rho\text{ near }\tfrac12,\qquad t_c(s)=\frac{1-3\rho^2+2\rho^3}{27},\\ t_c(0)=\tfrac1{54},\qquad q=t-t_c(s),\qquad P_{\rm sel}(0)=e^{-2\pi i/3}. \end{gathered} \] Use every actual good cap \(m=3l\), \(l\ge1\), either primitive norm \(n=\pm1\), each admitted finite character and the complete prescribed annular reference. Fix the original nonzero scalar \(\lambda_0\) in the common strict-contraction range described below. Traverse one positive original s-circle with its actual identity source closing, full root closing and original physical circle. For the initial fan and every vertical selected fan \(T_j=\left(\begin{smallmatrix}1&0\\j&1\end{smallmatrix}\right)\), the physical Jin completion and the actual native normal product have \[ (k_M,\ell_M)=(-3,-12),\qquad (\mu,\nu)=(-3,0),\qquad A_M=0. \] Here \(k_M=\langle x^3,[M_f]\rangle\), \(\ell_M=\langle p_1(TM_f)x,[M_f]\rangle\), \(x=c_1(M)\), and M is the original nonzero-vector physical line of P3K.68. The native pair is obtained through the explicit held-quaternion and physical-line map in the proof. For any selected lattice-basis fan \(P\in\mathrm{GL}_2(\mathbb Z)\), put \((x,y)^t=P^{-1}(0,1)^t\) and \(S=x^2+xy+y^2\). The complete actual directed fan construction has integer path sum and oriented sphere class \[ A(P)=-\frac38(S-1)(S-3),\qquad [\Sigma(P)]=[A(P)]_{28}\in\Theta_7=\mathbb Z/28. \] Its exact image is \[ \{0,3,4,5,7,10,11,12,14,17,18,19,21,24,25,26\}. \] Every class is attained by an explicit determinant-one basis whose full native word and intermediate products are retained below. The construction carries all original source, point-line, normal, cap, finite-character, reference and closing arrows for every stated good cap and fan.

old_row.statement: P3K.71 computes the selected-cusp source return on every lattice-basis fan. P3K.72--74 give the full corrected scalar-fan algorithms in their specified whole-zero source scope. P3K.85--91 complete the following additional sectors through their actual source, Cartier, root, normal and inverse-closing maps. For the source-zero E7 branches put \[ (a,b,m)=(1,2,4p)\quad\hbox{or}\quad(2,1,4p-1),\qquad N=km,\quad \mu=2-a+6pk. \] The scalar is \(\lambda=v^N\lambda_0\); the fixed-scalar case is \(k=0\). For every vertical fan \(T_j\), P3K.89 proves \[ \begin{aligned} A_j={}&2b\binom{j+1}{3}+(3-b)\binom{j+1}{2} +k(a-1)(3p-1)-km\binom j2,\\ (k_M,\ell_M)={}&(\mu+6A_j,4\mu). \end{aligned} \] The full normal clutch used here is computed in P3K.86. P3K.90 transports these free integer data to every \(P\in\mathrm{GL}_2(\mathbb Z)\) by the actual two-ruling maps and the uniquely solved integral target-prism system. P3K.88 supplies explicit fixed-scalar fan witnesses for every element of \(\Theta_7\) on each branch. For the component-supported OS49 source, P3K.77--79 complete all one-cap lattice-basis fans, marked smooth order-one clutches and fixed-source holomorphic endpoints. P3K.81 supplies the exact integral obstructions for the additional smooth caps and good-II caps treated there. P3K.84--85 construct the two actual finite caps \(m=3k\), \(h=6l+1\) and their positive canonical return. With the full ordinary-clutch integer \(\sigma\), P3K.91 proves \[ D=hn_A+mn_B+mh\sigma=\epsilon=\pm1,\qquad H^2(\mathcal H)=\mathbb Z\oplus\mathbb Z/k\oplus\mathbb Z/h. \] The class is \((D,d_A\bmod k,d_B\bmod h)\). Its complete holomorphic endpoint group is the physical \(\mathbb C^*\). The actual shortest parameter \(w=r^3\), \(\lambda=w^{kh}\), has positive-fan physical pair \((2kh,8k(3l+1))\) and integer \(kl\). P3K.87 and P3K.91 compute every fan and every admitted winding \(Nkh\), with the endpoint and native covering maps constructed before integral characteristic naturality is applied. P3K.92 completes the infinity boundary of the marked E7 four-boundary parameter family on every fan. In its exact marking, \[ I_a(P)=-Z_a(P)-Z_a(JP)-C(P)\pmod {28},\qquad J=\operatorname{diag}(-1,1). \] The branch reflection and the infinity rescaling are given by their full character maps. The infinity root endpoint retains \(A^4D^{-4}=S_{r_0^{4n}}L^4\), its inverse scalar path on both ordinary and cap charts, and the actual transported lattice period \(-n(2\omega_1+2\omega_2)\). The two unselected \(v=1/8\) discs have the P3K.53 extension. P3K.93 evaluates that complete algorithm in closed form. Put \((x,y)^t=P^{-1}(0,1)^t\) and \(S=x^2+xy+y^2\). Then \[ I_a(P)=1-a-3(a-1)(S-1)-\frac{2a+1}{4}(S-1)(S-3) \pmod {28}. \] The proof supplies the full paired prism equations, the common first-step seed and both generator identities. Its complete images are \(\{0,6,8,10,14,20,22,24\}\) for \(a=1\) and \(\{5,7,9,13,19,21,23,27\}\) for \(a=2\), with an actual unimodular fan witness for every entry. The outstanding work is the remaining marked source-moduli generators, singular-site sectors and endpoint scopes outside the completed families just listed. In the E6 family \[ y^2=x^3+rx^2+tx+t^2,\qquad G=(0,t), \] P3K.94 completes the unselected \(r=0\) collision for the actual line \(M_6=\mathcal O(6G-O)\), suspension by \(-G\), and the quadratic reduced \(IV^*\) cap, with either signed primitive norm, each retained character, the full reference annular map and every selected lattice-basis fan. Its complete proper disc family has identity closing, so each of the corresponding marked-cover generators \(w^2=3/2\) has return zero. Its proof retains the full section \((t-t_{\rm sel})B_6/t^3\), the root coefficient \(4h\), the signed norm and every source/line period cochain. P3K.96 extends this disc construction to both full progressions \[ (a,b;m)=(6,1;3l+2),\quad l\ge0, \qquad (a,b;m)=(2,3;3l),\quad l\ge1. \] The root fibres are respectively reduced type \(IV\) and smooth elliptic. The proof gives the actual higher A2 translation, every regular graph ray \((j,1)\), both section coefficient maps, the good-root exceptional correction, the literal chord lift with central coefficient one, its full norm unit of value four, every finite character, and the complete reference-relative annular cochain. For both primitive norm signs and every selected lattice-basis fan, the proper source-disc family has identity closing and return zero. P3K.97 completes the native E6 infinity-coordinate disc at either \(w^2=3\), for both cap progressions of P3K.96. The actual source, Cartier, root, physical-circle and annular maps carry the punctured original family to a proper smooth sphere family on the full native disc. Both point and tensor Tate frames, every finite character, the transported period discrepancy and the full scalar closing are retained. Each prescribed lattice-basis fan and both primitive norm signs have marked positive \(w\)-loop return zero. The exact original parameter is \[ \epsilon=1/r=(w^2-3)^2/(3-2w^2). \] This marked loop has degree two over the original infinity meridian; no shorter original-parameter endpoint or return is inferred. The \(r=1/4\) order-three collision has the exact central line divisor \(3F-C_1+C_2\) and actual two-ruling multiplier \(8\lambda q w^{-3}\). P3K.99--100 complete its original quadratic norm-one return and every selected fan. P3K.103 carries both integral characteristic numbers through the full higher-cap product comparison for every reduced \(M_6\) cap \(m=3l+2\), both primitive norm signs and each finite character/reference in the common fixed-scalar contraction range. The vertical pair is \((-27,-12)\), native pair \((-3,-24)\); every fan has the formula and sixteen-value image of P3K.100. P3K.95 completes the E6 selected-cusp generator on the ordered \(w\)-cover for \(M_6\), suspension by \(-G\), and the quadratic cap, with both primitive norm signs, all retained characters and full reference annular maps, and every selected lattice-basis fan. The exact source, Cartier, root, exterior, normal and Cox arrows identify its full all-fan algorithm with P3K.71. On the vertical fan \(T_j\) its physical pair and class are \[ (k_M,\ell_M)=(-6-18j(j-1),0),\qquad [\Sigma_j]=-1-3j(j-1)\pmod {28}. \] Its native free pair is \((0,-6-18j(j-1))\). The actual parameter map satisfies \(r-1/3=-w^4/(3(w^2-3)^2)\), so the stated ordered loop has degree four over the original source parameter. P3K.98 extends this full selected-cusp calculation to both complete cap progressions of P3K.96, with the same fixed scalar, both norm signs, every finite character and complete annular reference. Its actual point-to-tensor line arrow, all higher root graphs, even-parameter annular map and both normal caps identify the exact vertical free pair above and every K71 fan step. The full smooth-fibre theta reflection and its target period give the actual height-one arrow; the relative \(p_1\) calculation carries the explicit regular-level cobordism and its boundary transgression. P3K.101 completes the original \(M_6,(m,n)=(2,1)\) selected-infinity initial fan with the actual moving-bundle \(c_2=-4\), physical Jin pair \((-4,8)\), native pair \((2,-6)\) and class \(27\). P3K.102 gives every selected lattice-basis fan of that same full positive epsilon loop and retained reference. Its full vertical pair is \((-4-12j(j-1),8)\); its exact all-fan algorithm has precisely the fourteen odd residues. The complete original-height period winding, relative line/tangent/collar maps, endpoint reflection and all directed ordinary-prism resets are part of that proof. P3K.104 carries both integral selected-infinity characteristic numbers and the entire fan algorithm through every reduced \(M_6\) cap \(m=3l+2\), both primitive norm signs and each finite character/full reference, using the fixed original scalar in the common strict contraction range. Its source/root/Cartier maps retain the actual selected-height unit and its full root, every signed annular cochain and the complete endpoint word. The product of the two cap families has the prescribed common boundary; matched connections prove the two integral equalities. The signed meridian lattices and separate Hopf orbit/conifold maps fix the physical line and orientation. Thus all these caps have initial physical pair \((-4,8)\), native pair \((2,-6)\), and the same full vertical and all-fan results of P3K.102. P3K.105 constructs the entire original \(M_2\) selected-infinity progression with translation by \(-3G\), every good cap \(m=3l\), both primitive norm signs, every finite character/full reference and every selected fan. Its three chronological source maps, full genuine point-to-theta arrow, ordinary and selected chart matrices, integral normal ledger and actual moving-cap clutch give initial physical pair \((-4,8)\), native pair \((2,-6)\) and integer \(-1\) directly. The full good-root graph keeps both \(E_P-E_O\) Cartier corrections, the signed annular reference and both endpoint directions. Its prescribed cap products compare the two characteristic numbers separately and retain the full K102 vertical and all-fan formulas. The \(M_2\) order-three base return, both selected-I3 generators and their remaining cap/norm/fan scopes, and the additional singular-site/endpoint scopes still require their full comparison maps. The working notes assign no return to an unfinished attachment. Part 3.4 remains incomplete.
